name: standing-still
about: Yung Lean 'Storm II' / 'like an empty fire' tribute-formation trend. Original: one guy takes a smoke break, walks back into a formation of people in identical outfits, and on the beat drop everyone dances except him. Our version: Teddy is the guy (chewing a sunflower seed instead of smoking), the whole formation is identical Ichigos in matching teal sweaters. Post manually from the Instagram app with the Storm II sound.
scene: A tiny hamster-sized dance floor in the cosy attic living room: the patchwork sofa pushed back, warm string lights strung along the rafters, polished wooden floorboards catching the light, evening. Seven identical Ichigos (small silvery-white winter white dwarf hamsters, charcoal-grey dorsal stripe, grey-tipped ears) stand in a neat formation of two rows, perfectly still, facing the viewer, every one of them wearing the same little dusty-teal knitted sweater. In the middle of the front row there is one empty gap. Teddy (large, round, shaggy apricot-orange teddy bear hamster, cream belly, roughly twice their size) wears the exact same dusty-teal sweater and stands just to the left of the formation, one step away from the gap, holding a single sunflower seed in both stubby paws, mid-chew, cheeks slightly puffed, deadpan expression, looking straight at the viewer.
frameNote:
This painting is the FIRST FRAME of a 10-second animation, shown full screen on a vertical phone.
- Tall vertical 9:16 composition, straight-on, eye level, like a dance video filmed on a phone.
- The formation fills the middle band of the frame. Every hamster fully visible with a little space between each one, so they can move without merging.
- Keep the top 15% and bottom 20% free of anything important; Instagram overlays its interface there.
- Everyone frozen in a calm, upright standing pose. No motion blur.
- All seven Ichigos look identical to the Ichigo reference. Teddy looks exactly like the Teddy reference. Teddy is clearly the biggest and the focal point.
motion:
0-3s: Teddy waddles two small steps to the right and settles into the empty gap in the middle of the front row, still slowly chewing his sunflower seed. All the Ichigos stand perfectly still, facing the camera.
3-4s: on the beat drop, every Ichigo bursts at the exact same moment into the same bouncy synchronized hamster dance: little hops side to side, tiny paws raised, heads bobbing, ears and cheeks bouncing.
4-10s: the Ichigos keep dancing in perfect sync. Teddy stands completely motionless in the middle of them, chewing slowly, deadpan, staring straight into the camera, not moving at all. Around 7s the Ichigo beside him glances at him mid-dance and keeps going.
Camera: locked off, straight-on, eye level, the whole time.
caption: Everyone knew the choreography. Teddy knew his snack.
transferPrompt:
Recreate the source video's exact motion, timing, camera and formation, but with these characters and this look:

THE MAIN PERFORMER (the one who walks back into formation and then stands still while everyone dances) becomes TEDDY: the large, round, shaggy apricot-orange teddy bear hamster from the reference images, cream belly, wearing a little dusty-teal knitted sweater. Where the source shows smoking, Teddy is instead holding and slowly chewing a single sunflower seed. He stands completely still and deadpan while everyone else dances, exactly like the main performer.

EVERY PERSON IN THE CROWD becomes ICHIGO: the small silvery-white winter white dwarf hamster from the reference images, charcoal-grey dorsal stripe, grey-tipped ears. All crowd members are identical Ichigos wearing the same dusty-teal knitted sweater. They copy the crowd's dance moves as bouncy hamster movements.

WORLD: the cosy hamster-sized attic from the first reference image, warm string lights, wooden floor. No humans anywhere.

STYLE LOCK: hand-painted storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, visible brushwork, warm light. Not 3D, not photoreal. All hamsters have solid glossy black bead eyes, four paws, and keep their shape: nothing morphs or melts. No text, no logos, no cigarettes, no smoke.
